title: Small Business Judging Judges
eligible_reason: Treatment is continuous: the change in the liberal-judge count on the county's federal appellate circuit (circuit_liberalchange_new = f1 count minus l6 count; district analogue liberalchange_new), regressed on the percent change in firms (changefirm) in border counties with border-pair x year FE (absorb(year##circuitborder)) and no county FE, weighted by lagged firms, clustered by border. The one binary specification (Table with c.post##c.lib_treated, Replicate_Circuit_Main_V1.do lines 115-133) is a windowed event design: lib_treated = circuit experienced its maximum liberal shock, event_year in (-4, 0], post = event_year > -2, first-differenced outcome, border-pair x year FE only, with an additive post term (absorbed) and lib_treated main effect; no unit FE and a single 'big shock' per circuit. Not a staggered binary adoption TWFE.
design_notes: County-year panel (BDS) 1989-2016 restricted to counties on borders between federal judicial circuits (border_county==1) or districts (district_border_county==1). Main: reghdfe changefirm circuit_liberalchange_new circuit_liberalchange_1 [pweight=lag_firms] if border_county==1, absorb(year##circuitborder) cluster(circuitborder), with/without $controlvars5_chg (lagged growth controls). Heterogeneity by post2/gf (good-faith exemption), litigation risk by sector with year##circuitborder##sector2 and year##fipscty##fipstate FE. Data construction in Data_processing_main_V1.do (lines 1291, 1440-1463, 1673).

ineligible_specs.reason: continuous ideology-change regressor; first-differenced outcome; no county FE
binary shock spec within a 5-year window, post = event_year > -2, no unit FE; one shock per circuit

data_files: raw_data/ (judgesnew.dta, bds_cty_year_ind.dta, bds_cty_year_age.dta, bds2020_st_cty.csv, CAINC1 BEA csv, county adjacency, US Chamber ratings, Fig1data.dta, etc.)
Replication_Data/ is empty in the archive (built by Data_processing_main_V1.do)
data_files_note: All inputs are public; processed datasets must be rebuilt by running the data-processing do-file.
screener_notes: Screened from package only; the manuscript PDF is in the package (paper/) but was not needed to classify the design. The ft_borusyak flag likely reflects a Borusyak-Jaravel-Spiess citation rather than an imputation estimate (no did_imputation call in the code).
